result.summary: The food delivery app page renders well overall. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and horizontal scrolling cards being cut off.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' third card (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, though this is expected for a horizontally scrollable carousel.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partial card visibly indicates scrollability, and consider adding a subtle fade or peek to signal more content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without an ellipsis clearly finishing the label in the visible area.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis or allow full name display on scroll.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is partially cut off by the navigation bar, showing incomplete content.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but verify adequate bottom padding so cards aren't obscured by the fixed nav bar.
